slice_6_sb40_grouping.what: SB-24's 'Moved out' list is grouped, not flat — SB-40. Everyone who asked for the same day AND the same shoot clusters together under one 'Build a set from these' button; a different day or a different shoot is its own cluster, so a set built from one group can never quietly re-import the disagreement everyone was moved out for.
slice_6_sb40_grouping.no_backend_or_db_change: Every field the grouping needs (deferred_go_live_date, deferred_shoot_mode) already exists from migration 167. Pure client-side grouping over data already returned by GET /campaigns/:id/deferred. Nothing to migrate, nothing new to fetch.

app.groupDeferred(): new, BrandCampaignBuilderScreen.js. Groups by the exact (day, shoot) pair as given — a day-only or shoot-only ask groups with others who gave exactly that same partial answer, never folded into an 'any shoot' bucket that would invent agreement nobody stated. Sorted soonest-day-first; no-day groups sort last.
app.buildSetFromGroup(ids): replaces the old buildSetFromDeferred() — takes one group's ids, not everyone's. A brand with three different asks in the pool now gets three buttons, each seeding only its own cluster.

slice_6_sb40_grouping.tests: 576 mobile tests pass (was 573). campaignBuilderDeferred.test.js rewritten for grouping: same-day-and-shoot clusters together, same-day-different-shoot stays separate, day-only and shoot-only asks still form real clusters, sort order, and each button carries only its own group's ids.

slice_7_cold_invite_search.architecture_decision: Founder, 2026-09-02: "we don't have pre-agreed and adding into sets type of concept now... only way campaign, sets, and reach to creator and negotiations start." Retires the pre-campaign handshake (brand_collab_requests / influencer_proposals / collab_agreements) as the way NEW collaborations begin. Nothing was torn out — this session confirmed via a full research pass that the old tables/screens/endpoints are additive and safe to simply stop feeding; existing rows and their read-only dependents (contract.service.js, production.service.js, influencer.controller.js's settled-terms display, publishGate.service.js) are untouched. Production data on the old pathway was confirmed by the founder to be disposable test data — no migration-away plan needed.
slice_7_cold_invite_search.the_actual_gap_closed: The set-building wizard's 'who's in it' step could ONLY add creators from a pre-existing agreement. There was no way to search for and invite someone fresh — the one piece of real, new work this slice does. The equivalent already existed and was proven live on the brand-web dashboard; this ports that exact pattern to the phone, reusing mobile API bindings (searchInfluencers/inviteInfluencer) that already existed in api.js but were never wired to anything.
slice_7_cold_invite_search.no_backend_or_db_change: GET /influencers/search and POST /campaigns/:id/sets/:sid/invite already existed and already supported everything needed (search returns onboarded creators only for a brand caller; invite already accepts a cold creator with agreement_id omitted). This slice is 100% mobile app code.

app.campaignDraft.addColdInvite / isColdInvi: a creator found by search is keyed `cold:<influencer_id>` (same synthetic-key pattern as the deferred pool's `deferred:` prefix) since she has no real agreement to key by. isRealAgreementId (the guard that keeps synthetic keys out of the server payload) extended to recognise both prefixes.
app.BrandFindCreatorsScreen.js: gained a third mode (forSet) alongside its existing addToGroupId mode — same search/filter/multi-select UI, already proven, a different action at the bottom ('Add N to this set' instead of 'Ask N'/'Add to group'). Someone already in the set is shown greyed, not hidden.
app.BrandSetWizardScreen.js — StepCreators: gained '+ Find someone new' and a 'Found by search' list (same fix class as the deferred pool: without a visible list, a search-added creator would be counted in `picked` but invisible on this step).
app.CreatorTermsScreen.js (SB-30): for a cold-invited creator, 'Already agreed' becomes 'Your opening offer' — an EDITABLE commission/fee field instead of a read-back, since nothing is settled. She can still negotiate it afterwards through the negotiate/respond system that already exists for exactly this case (a cold invite inside a real set) — confirmed working, unmodified, before writing any of this.
app.canFinish gained everyoneHasMoney: a cold-invited creator with no stated commission/fee would otherwise publish with agreed_fee/commission_pct null — the exact 'FEE ₹0' bug this codebase has already paid for once. Agreement-sourced and deferred-seeded creators are unaffected (they already have real numbers).

slice_7_cold_invite_search.bug_caught_by_mounting_the_screen: BrandFindCreatorsScreen already had local filter-sheet state named `draft`/`setDraft` (pre-existing, unrelated to campaignDraft). Adding `import * as draft from campaignDraft` collided with it silently — no parse error, no lint warning, just `draft.addColdInvite` resolving to the local state variable (always null) instead of the module. The render test calling the real 'Add to set' button caught it immediately with 'Cannot read properties of null'; a source-shape check would have passed clean. Fixed by renaming the local state to filterDraft/setFilterDraft.
slice_7_cold_invite_search.tests: 591 mobile tests pass (was 582). 3 new files (findCreatorsForSet.test.js, creatorTermsMoney.test.js, plus additions to creatorTermsDraft.test.js), all exercising real behaviour — not source text — per the standing lesson from this slice's own shadowing bug and the earlier 'storys' pluralisation bug.
slice_7_cold_invite_search.what_was_deliberately_not_done_this_pass: Closing the old front doors (BrandFindCreatorsScreen's original 'Ask N' request-sending action, the creator's own pitch-browsing screen) — founder asked specifically to build the missing capability first.
